Original Montreal university computer science research lab; NO people, NO characters, NO user interface, NO captions, NO legible text, NO brand logos. The lower 38% of the scene is broad clear orange wooden FLOOR with enormous uneven boards, keep x40%-80%, y65%-96% uncluttered for a game character to walk there. Strong intentionally art-directed asymmetric composition. Original artwork, no recreation of any existing game's actual room or characters.
